svg.title: Automation: a desk, a terminal and the keyboard typing into it
svg.desc: A desk: a terminal above a 3D 75% RGB keyboard and a mouse on an RGB-edged mat, cabled to the screen. The keyboard types this repo's pipeline key by key (gen-profile builds 26 SVG files, the tests pass, git push hands over to GitHub Actions); the mouse clicks before each command.

g.text: 26 svg files from one set of design tokens
GitHub Actions keeps the numbers current
